name: PEG
shortDescription: CDC-recommended 3-item scale tracking weekly pain intensity, enjoyment of life, and general activity interference.
timeframe: Thinking about your pain during the past week, select the number from 0 to 10 that best describes your experience:
citation: Krebs EE, Lorenz KA, Bair MJ, et al. J Gen Intern Med. 2009;24(6):733-738.

questions.text: What number best describes your pain on average in the past week?

options.label: 10 — Pain as bad as you can imagine

questions.text: What number best describes how, during the past week, pain has interfered with your enjoyment of life?
What number best describes how, during the past week, pain has interfered with your general activity?

scoring.formulaDescription: Mean (average) of all 3 items rated 0–10 (range 0–10). Standard clinical pain benchmarks: 0 None, 0.5–3.9 Mild, 4.0–6.9 Moderate, 7.0–10 Severe. A ≥30% reduction over time is typically considered clinically meaningful improvement.
